_comment_deployables: Services with their own container and their own PROD version. These are the only repos accepted as keys in the --versions input.
_comment_display_names: Cosmetic names for repos that are discovered as bundled dependencies rather than listed above.
_comment_package_to_repo: Overrides for npm package name -> GitHub repo name. By default the '@nominal-systems/' scope is stripped and the remainder is used as the repo name; only add entries here when that derivation is wrong.
_comment_npm_scope: Dependencies under this scope are treated as first-party and followed into their own repository.
_comment_excluded: Repos deliberately left out of the release note, with the reason printed in the footer.

excluded.dmi-engine-heska-integration: Deprecated - no longer built or deployed.
excluded.dmi-api-admin-ui: Operator tooling, released on its own cadence and not part of the DMI PROD service set.
excluded.dmi-e2e: Test harness, not deployed to PROD.
excluded.dmi-cli: Developer tooling, not deployed to PROD.
excluded.dmi-monitor: Monitoring sidecar, released on its own cadence.

_comment_bundled_max_depth: How many levels of first-party dependency to follow (1 = direct deps of the deployables only).
